title: Deposit initiation, booking and source reconciliation
workflow: Validate account eligibility, receiving branch and approved currency
Obtain verifiable cash acceptance or external settlement evidence
Request balanced immutable ledger posting only under approved mapping
Reconcile receipt and authoritative journal with cash/rail source
Issue customer receipt referencing completed transaction and exceptions
invariants: Unverified incoming payment notification is not a funded deposit
No deposit should create money solely from an API response
Branch cash custody and bank accounting require independent reconciliation
Posted journal cannot be updated for a customer correction
Duplicate deposit receipt cannot create duplicate postings
Suspended or closed account follows approved acceptance/return rule
planned_tests: External transfer acknowledgement without settlement cannot post
Duplicate cash receipt results in one deposit
Failed ledger posting remains recoverable exception
approval_gate: Approved cash or external settlement source, PCEC mapping, CFO and operations acceptance.
